anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of De Oratione exists (only copyrighted Greer/O'Meara/Oulton-Chadwick); nothing to compare against. Sense checked against the Greek and cited Scripture wording.

apparatus: East by nature (phusei) over position (thesei); field test universalizes.

choices.english: nature must be ranked before position
choices.why: phusis/thesis is the philosophical pair; liturgical east stands on nature, not building orientation.

pass_a_gloss: Single-section chapter: pray eastward, soul toward the True Light's rising; doors/openings yield to nature; the field (no doors) proves the universal rule.
